behavior: An item of `Menu` or `Select` does not activate for the release of the trigger press that opened the popup when the release comes within 5 px of the point of the press on each axis. The open can put an item under a pointer that does not move: a layout change can move the trigger, and `alignItemWithTrigger` puts the selected item of `Select`, or its first item, under the pointer. Base UI activates that item when the release comes 200 ms or more after the press (`Menu`), or 400 ms or more after the open (`Select`): the menu runs the action of the item, and the select commits the value of the item. The rule applies in each mode of `Select`, also when the popup aligns the selected item with the trigger. A native pop-up button of macOS commits the selected item and closes for a release with no move after a hold. Vase UI keeps the popup open, so one gesture has one result in each mode and for each duration of the press. A release more than 5 px from the point of the press still activates the item under it.
